text: As I enter this modern, glass-walled space, I feel curiosity and anticipation about what lies beyond. The environment is pristine and slightly clinical, yet holds the promise of discovery. Stepping further and seeing the R+D wall display, I feel inspired—a sense of reverence for human ingenuity and the pioneering spirit of research and development. The vibrant colors and digital screens underscore an atmosphere of innovation. I am alert, present, and open to the ideas unfolding around me.
